summary: The agent successfully applies thorough data cleaning, feature engineering (including proper out-of-fold target encoding), and cross-validated training across three robust gradient boosting frameworks. However, the solution leaks test data into the training set through combined feature engineering (FM02), uses a completely untuned and hardcoded ensemble blend (FM12), fails to report any cross-validation metric to estimate performance, and critically hardcodes sequential IDs in the final output file which risks a complete submission failure.
